title: Three Marks mod replay auto-upload
description:
Opt-in (config upload_replays, off by default), hangar-only. POST /replays/mod as multipart/form-data with exactly one file part named by #/definitions/limits field, holding the player's own .wotreplay/.mtreplay as the client wrote it. The mod sends X-Otmetki-Visibility: private (default, only the owner sees the replay) or public (config publish_replays, off by default); without the header the server stores the replay as private. Signed like /mod/ingest (X-Otmetki-Device, X-Otmetki-Timestamp, X-Otmetki-Nonce, X-Otmetki-Signature = sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "v2
POST
/replays/mod
<timestamp>
<nonce>
x-otmetki-visibility:<visibility>
" + raw file bytes)>): a sent X-Otmetki-Visibility is a signed header, one lower-case name:value line between the nonce and the body, so it cannot be added, stripped or changed; the HMAC covers the raw file bytes, not the multipart envelope, because the server verifies it after parsing the form. The server buffers the whole part (no chunked or resumable protocol) and refuses a declared Content-Length above max_bytes + multipart_overhead_bytes before reading. Responses: 201 #/definitions/response, also when the owner sends a file (sha256) they uploaded before (the stored replay is answered again); 409 when another account already uploaded the same file (the other upload is not named), which the mod treats as done; 400 invalid, too large or an unknown visibility (dropped); 401 unknown device or bad signature (rebind); 403 FORBIDDEN (revoked device, rebind) or SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED (stored replays limit, long backoff); 428 stale timestamp, refused from the headers before the file is read (re-sign once with the Date/X-Otmetki-Server-Time clock); 422 replay_not_owned when the replay header's recorder (playerID) is not the device's bound account (dropped); 429 rate limited (Retry-After). Every error reply carries X-Otmetki-Server-Time. The mod uploads only replays whose header playerID equals the bound account and whose arenaUniqueID (or start time when the results block is missing) matches a battle of that account, deduplicated by arenaUniqueID.

limits.description: Constants shared by the mod (otmetki/replays.py) and the server (REPLAY_UPLOAD in apps/web/server/src/modules/replays/config).

response.description: 201 response. The replay is parsed asynchronously.

error.description: 4xx response of the site API error shape.
Free text, or the mod error code (replay_not_owned, bad_signature, stale_request, ...) for the mod's own failures.

code.description: REPLAY_INVALID, REPLAY_DUPLICATE, SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, RATE_LIMITED, ...
